extensions.name: Niagara Tools
extensions.description: AI tools for Unreal's Niagara VFX system (list/inspect systems, spawn components).

tools.name: niagara-list-systems
tools.description: List every Niagara system (UNiagaraSystem) asset in the project (read-only), optionally filtered by a content-path prefix.

tools.name: niagara-get-system
tools.description: Inspect a single Niagara system asset (read-only) and report its emitters.

tools.name: niagara-spawn-component
tools.description: Spawn a Niagara component for a system into the active editor world at a location.

extensions.name: EnhancedInput Tools
extensions.description: AI tools for Unreal's Enhanced Input system (list/inspect Input Actions & Mapping Contexts, create actions/contexts, add key mappings).

tools.name: enhanced-input-list
tools.description: Lists every Enhanced Input asset in the project via the Asset Registry, without loading any of them: Input Actions (UInputAction) and Mapping Contexts (UInputMappingContext). Optionally filter by a content-path prefix.

tools.name: enhanced-input-get
tools.description: Inspects a single Enhanced Input asset (read-only): for a UInputAction reports its value type; for a UInputMappingContext reports its key -> action mappings.

tools.name: enhanced-input-action-create
tools.description: Creates a UInputAction asset (an Enhanced Input action) at a content path, with an optional value type (Boolean | Axis1D | Axis2D | Axis3D). Optionally saves it to disk.

tools.name: enhanced-input-context-create
tools.description: Creates a UInputMappingContext asset (an Enhanced Input mapping context) at a content path. Optionally saves it to disk.

tools.name: enhanced-input-add-mapping
tools.description: Adds a key -> action mapping to a UInputMappingContext, binding an FKey to a UInputAction. Optionally saves it to disk.

extensions.name: PCG Tools
extensions.description: AI tools for Unreal's Procedural Content Generation (PCG) framework (list/inspect graphs, add & inspect PCG components, trigger generation).

tools.name: pcg-list-graphs
tools.description: Lists every PCG graph (UPCGGraph) asset in the project via the Asset Registry, without loading any of them. Optionally filter by a content-path prefix.

tools.name: pcg-get-graph
tools.description: Inspects a single PCG graph asset (read-only) and reports its nodes.

tools.name: pcg-add-component
tools.description: Adds a UPCGComponent to a named actor in the active editor world, optionally bound to a PCG graph asset.

tools.name: pcg-get-component
tools.description: Inspects the UPCGComponent on a named actor in the active editor world (read-only): its bound graph and generation state.

tools.name: pcg-generate
tools.description: Triggers PCG generation (refresh) on the UPCGComponent of a named actor in the active editor world.

extensions.name: GAS Tools
extensions.description: AI tools for Unreal's Gameplay Ability System (list abilities/effects/attribute sets, inspect an ability, grant an ability to an actor).

tools.name: gas-list-abilities
tools.description: Lists every Gameplay Ability class (UGameplayAbility subclass — native C++ and Blueprint) known to the project via the Asset Registry, without loading any of them. Optionally filter by a class-path prefix.

tools.name: gas-list-effects
tools.description: Lists every Gameplay Effect class (UGameplayEffect subclass — native C++ and Blueprint) known to the project via the Asset Registry, without loading any of them. Optionally filter by a class-path prefix.

tools.name: gas-list-attribute-sets
tools.description: Lists every Attribute Set class (UAttributeSet subclass — native C++ and Blueprint) known to the project via the Asset Registry, without loading any of them. Optionally filter by a class-path prefix.

tools.name: gas-inspect-ability
tools.description: Inspects a single Gameplay Ability class (read-only) by loading its class default object and reporting its configuration: gameplay tags, cost/cooldown Gameplay Effect classes, and instancing policy.

tools.name: gas-grant-ability
tools.description: Grants a Gameplay Ability to a named actor's AbilitySystemComponent in the active editor world (the actor must already own an AbilitySystemComponent).

extensions.name: Landscape Tools
extensions.description: AI tools for Unreal's Landscape + Water systems (inspect landscapes, water bodies & zones).

tools.name: landscape-list-actors
tools.description: Lists every Landscape actor / proxy in the active editor world (read-only), reporting class, whether it is the primary ALandscape (vs a streaming proxy), and component count.

tools.name: landscape-get-actor
tools.description: Inspects a single Landscape actor by name (read-only): section layout (componentSizeQuads / subsectionSizeQuads / numSubsections), component count, landscape material, and paint layers.

tools.name: landscape-list-water-bodies
tools.description: Lists every Water body actor in the active editor world (read-only), reporting its type (River / Lake / Ocean / Custom) and spline-point count.

tools.name: landscape-get-water-body
tools.description: Inspects a single Water body by name (read-only): type, spline-point count, water material, and owning water zone.

tools.name: landscape-list-water-zones
tools.description: Lists every Water zone actor in the active editor world (read-only), reporting world location and 2D zone extent.

extensions.name: ControlRig Tools
extensions.description: AI tools for Unreal's Control Rig (list/inspect rig blueprints, controls, bones, and actor components).

tools.name: control-rig-list
tools.description: Lists every Control Rig blueprint (UControlRigBlueprint) asset in the project via the Asset Registry, without loading any of them. Optionally filter by a content-path prefix. Returns { count, controlRigs:[{ name, path }] }.

tools.name: control-rig-get
tools.description: Inspects a single Control Rig blueprint asset (read-only) and reports its rig element hierarchy. Returns { path, name, boneCount, nullCount, controlCount, curveCount, elementCount, elements:[{ name, type }] }.

tools.name: control-rig-list-controls
tools.description: Lists the control elements of a Control Rig blueprint (read-only), each with its control type (e.g. Float, Transform, Bool). Returns { path, controlCount, controls:[{ name, controlType }] }.

tools.name: control-rig-list-bones
tools.description: Lists the bone elements of a Control Rig blueprint (read-only), each with its immediate parent bone (empty for a root). Returns { path, boneCount, bones:[{ name, parent }] }.

tools.name: control-rig-get-component
tools.description: Inspects the Control Rig component of an actor in the active editor world (read-only). Looks the actor up by its label. Returns { actorName, componentName, controlRigClass, hasControlRig } (controlRigClass is the bound rig instance's class, or "None" when no rig is bound) or a defensive error if the actor or component is not found.
